Specification: This module is a small model-checking helper module that augments an underlying specification imported from other modules. It defines a symmetry set for threads using permutations of Threads and defines the Cartesian product of Nodes with itself as the set of all directed edges between nodes. The file itself contains no variables, no actions, no temporal specification, and no proofs; it serves only as a thin wrapper of two top-level value definitions.
